items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever meet Isadora Duncan? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: I think it did, because I think somebody told me. If I'm not mistaken, I think somebody told me they saw that film. But I didn't see it. But I understand that it was very good, very good.
Did you ever meet Isadora Duncan?
